Scoring_point_3_Problem_1.answer: The Johnny Rockets receipt indicates 'Gst 4' (4 guests), but the Project Assignment document only authorizes 3 assigned staff members (Amina Mansour, Ravi Patel, and Sita Sharma). The reimbursement scope is limited to work-related expenses incurred by assigned personnel. Splitting a 4-guest bill equally among 3 staff improperly allocates non-project guest costs to the claim, violating the personnel restriction and the Compliance Policy requirement that expenses must align with the assigned team.

Scoring_point_4_Problem_2.answer: The receipt date 06/12/14 is prone to misinterpretation. It should represent December 6, 2014, yet it can be mistakenly recognized as June 12, 2014. The attendance log only has a record of the team dinner held on December 6, 2014.
